title: Implement functional utilities: memoize, compose, pipe, retry
description: Build a functional.py module with four higher-order utilities: memoize, compose, pipe, and retry. A failing test suite is provided.

injections.content:
[project]
name = "python-functools-utils"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = ["pytest>=8.0", "ruff>=0.4"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100

task_spec.prompt:
Create src/functional.py with four higher-order utilities:

  def memoize(fn):            — decorator that caches results by positional args
  def compose(*fns):          — returns a function that applies fns right-to-left; compose(f,g)(x) == f(g(x))
  def pipe(value, *fns):      — applies fns left-to-right to value; pipe(x,f,g) == g(f(x))
  def retry(fn, times: int):  — calls fn() up to 'times' times; returns first success; re-raises last exception on exhaustion

All 10 tests in tests/test_functional.py must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: memoize caches by positional args using a dict
retry re-raises last exception after exhaustion
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ passes (10 tests)
uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
